$description: Stepper tokens, shared by the desktop and mobile layouts. 2.x kept two token sets under `step-*` and `stepper-*`, which is why the two layouts drifted apart.

check-size.$description: The badge on a completed step. A badge rather than a filled marker: the step NUMBER stays readable, which is what tells you where you are in a flow.

check-offset.$description: How far the badge sits outside the marker's box, so it straddles the ring

line-gap.$description: Clearance between a marker and the connector in the horizontal layout, so the line stops short of the ring instead of running into it

line-gap-vertical.$description: The same clearance stacked. Smaller than the horizontal one on purpose: a vertical step is only as tall as its text, so the horizontal value would leave almost no line between two markers

vertical-step-gap.$description: Between steps when stacked. The horizontal layout needs none — its steps share the row with `flex: 1 1 0`. MUST exceed `line-gap-vertical` doubled, or a step whose content is no taller than its marker has no connector at all; `css:verify` checks it.

label-current-font-weight.$description: The step you are on reads heavier than the rest — the only thing in the row that says where you are now
